purpose: Machine-readable prebuild contract for dependency-safe T12 preparation. This file does not activate or approve T12 runtime work.

dependency_gate.activation_base: exact integration head containing T10 and T11 APPROVED/integrated completion records

validation_rules: level_id is exact canonical t12.level.NNN for its level and globally unique
exactly one shipping record exists for each level 1..100
region_band_id matches the frozen ten-level connected-world band
every prerequisite target exists and points only to an earlier level
required_fact_ids are stable accepted/activation-verified facts; preparation-only or provisional IDs cannot ship
prerequisite topology is acyclic and reachable from Level 1
every level declares at least one practical progression effect or unlock and exact effect payloads cannot be reused as filler
purchase/VIP/premium-spend/energy signals are not valid eligibility inputs
each level includes canonical completion event t12.event.level.NNN.completed
one-time event and visible-hook IDs are unique and deterministic
milestone references resolve to the milestone dataset at the same level
milestone_id is unique and stable in t12.milestone namespace
default major milestone at each ten-level boundary uses exact t12.milestone.NNN
milestone level exists in Level 1..100 records
owner_task identifies the task responsible for shipping content/behavior
T12 metadata cannot claim later-owner content is already implemented

upstream_bindings.contract: context/action state may be referenced for progression events; T12 cannot add permanent action-button complexity
resource/inventory/carrying truth may gate progression through published state only; T12 cannot mutate conserved quantities
world-transform identities/status may be referenced; T12 cannot debit or commit transform transactions
camp-state identities/completion may be referenced; T12 cannot spawn/modify camp content directly

explicitly_not_implemented_during_prep: T13 adaptive difficulty or Challenge Director
